devices.name: Wi-Fi Router
devices.description: Dark blue/black rectangular Wi-Fi router with a circular logo on its top. On the rear: a row of five RJ45 Ethernet sockets with two USB-A sockets beside them, and a power cable attached.

devices.name: PlayStation 5
devices.description: Original Sony PlayStation 5 (standard model, not Slim or Pro). Rear connections per Sony: one LAN port, one HDMI OUT port, two USB Type-A ports and an AC IN power connector.

devices.name: Samsung Television
devices.description: Large black Samsung television. Its rear/side connection panel has three HDMI-shaped inputs with two USB-A-style ports above them.
